page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and runs on a KVM hypervisor.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This storage configuration is bundled directly with the instance. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No GPU accelerators are included in this hardware profile.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers high storage density per resource unit, making it suitable for workloads requiring massive local capacity without the premium cost of solid-state drives. However, the use of HDD storage instead of SSDs represents a performance tradeoff, as sequential and random I/O speeds will be lower. This instance is best suited for storage-intensive workloads, large-scale data warehousing, log processing, and big data analytics frameworks that benefit from high-capacity local storage and dedicated compute resources.
